base_status: Both roles exist and are individually unique in Sym(ODir), but equality is not forced.

axioms.statement: For every d in ODir, q(rho(z)(d))=q(d).
For every d in ODir, rho(z)(d)!=d.

minimal_additional_package.proof: Fix d. S3 says q^{-1}(q(d)) has exactly two elements {d,delta_q(d)}. Verticality puts rho(z)(d) in this fiber. Fixed-point-freeness excludes d, so rho(z)(d)=delta_q(d). This holds for every d.
minimal_additional_package.sufficiency_theorem: Under S3 plus A*-VERTICALITY and A*-FIXED_POINT_FREE, rho(z)=delta_q exactly in Sym(ODir).

other_role_coherence.reason: Cut(K) and Sym(ODir) are distinct codomains; no comparison map is in S5/S3.
Generator inversion-orbits and ODir permutations are distinct types. The cover map only sends kernel elements to identity, not to the nonidentity direction involution.
A cellular boundary permutation and an affine-direction permutation require an explicit realization functor before comparison.

realization.consequence: R2_DIRECTION_DECK and R3_GROUP_INVOLUTION_ACTION coincide in every S4 realization, without a metric or scalar angle readout.
realization.statement: The ordered-affine positive-ray realization satisfies both A* axioms: scalar negation keeps the underlying one-dimensional subspace and has no fixed positive ray.
